assertions.name: m_p_matches_codata_within_1ppm
assertions.source: m_p substrate identity should match CODATA m_p within 1 ppm — observed 0.24 ppm, well within tolerance.

assertions.name: m_n_matches_codata_within_10ppb
assertions.source: m_n via the parameter-free Kashiwara b² Q_β (n→p+e+ν̄) should match CODATA m_n within 10 ppb. Under convention D it does not: +501 ppb (the ~1 ppb once recorded was convention C, excised). TIER: near-match; exact Q_β gated on the s5bb Habiro keystone.

assertions.name: borromean_v3_e3_plus_e21_equals_full_trace
assertions.source: Exact central idempotent trace decomposition tr(e_{(3)} V³) + tr(e_{(2,1)} V³) = tr(V³) on the 3-strand nucleon weight spaces W_p and W_n (QOU.BraidsAndKnots.NucleonWeightSpaceTwoTerm.trace_e3p_borromeanV3, trace_e21p_borromeanV3).

assertions.name: borromean_v3_conn_proton_closes_mup_gap_within_1sigma
assertions.source: RECORD OF A SELECTED COMBINATION, not a zero-parameter prediction (bean qou-99qc, 2026-11-19): connected 4th-order Borromean proton QED term M_p^QED,conn = m_e·|tr_bar_conn(p, V³)| (+0.220077 keV, QOU.BraidsAndKnots.NucleonWeightSpaceTwoTerm.trace_QAdjp_borromeanV3), with the m_e scale and the adjacent-pair restriction both chosen. Checks that the recorded combination reproduces +8.06 ppb = +0.36σ; it is not evidence that the μ–p tension (9.5σ on the ratio) is closed.

description: Production substrate-categorical prediction of m_p and m_n from (m_e, m_μ, q_0) using Lean-proved closed forms for |tr_M(β_Bor)| and [3]_q!. The neutron uses the 3-input chain m_n = m_p + Q_β + m_e with Q_β the parameter-free Kashiwara b² truncation (near-match, +501 ppb on m_n under convention D); the Hecke-skein flavor-split is a secondary ratio. CAL-3 (Q_β) is NOT used as input — Q_β becomes a DERIVED quantity. Substrate identity: m_p = 2·m_μ·|tr_M|·[3]_q!/q^3 - 12·m_e where the '12' is the Ocneanu cancellation reciprocal.

predictions_pathC.derivation: m_n = m_p + Q_β(Kashiwara b², parameter-free) + m_e

The real per-nucleus SDP (multi-term cost from this mass-identity formula + non-empty constraints) is per-nucleus substantive open work; see docs/coordination/2026-05-30-sdp-uniqueness-status.md.

two_term_borromean_qed_diagnostics.weighting_canonical: derived: Tr(K^{⊗3}·)/[2]_q³ (qou-99qc); *_MeV without suffix, *_Kp, *_KnKp, *_plain are historical
two_term_borromean_qed_diagnostics.note: Tier A non-breaking diagnostic block (bean qou-7ph7): evaluates the connected 4th-order Borromean V³ = (σ₁σ₂⁻¹)³ quark charge traces proved sorry-free in QOU/BraidsAndKnots/NucleonWeightSpaceTwoTerm.lean. WEIGHTING DERIVED 2026-11-20 (qou-99qc): Tr(K^{⊗3}·)/[2]_q³ (NucleonWeightSpaceQTrace), giving M_p^QED,conn = +0.0901243 keV and Δm_QED^conn = -0.1272243 keV (m_e scale); m_n_two_term / Q_beta_two_term use it. Historical 1/3-normalised 'plain': +0.220077 / -0.331696 keV. NOT DERIVED PREDICTIONS (bean qou-99qc, 2026-11-19): the word dependence comes only from dropping quark pair 1-3 (summed over all pairs the insertion is word-independent, trace_QPair_diff_word), and the scale/weighting were chosen against the μ–p and Q_β targets. Records of selected combinations; they do not close either residual.
